hazards.name: Orion Syndicate
hazards.behavior: Smuggling, contraband, kidnapping colonists, bribing your governors.
hazards.counter: Security patrols; buy them off; hire them against rivals.

hazards.name: Nausicaan Raiders
hazards.behavior: Hit-and-run on freighters and civilian transports.

hazards.name: Kazon Sects
hazards.behavior: Swarm attacks; try to steal replicator/transporter tech.

hazards.name: Hirogen Hunters
hazards.behavior: Track and target your highest-XP ship/captain.

hazards.name: Breen Privateers
hazards.behavior: Raid with energy dampeners; strand fleets.
